description: This is a Python source file that implements a prompt management system for integrating Arize Phoenix with LiteLLM. It defines classes to load, parse, render, and manage prompt templates fetched from Arize Phoenix, supporting workspace-based access control, templating with Jinja2, and integration with a larger prompt management framework.

classes.name: ArizePhoenixPromptTemplate
classes.description: Represents a prompt template loaded from Arize Phoenix, with attributes for template ID, messages, metadata, and rendering details.

classes.name: ArizePhoenixTemplateManager
classes.description: Manages loading and rendering of prompt templates from Arize Phoenix, supporting fetching prompt versions, parsing data, and templating with Jinja2.

classes.name: ArizePhoenixPromptManager
classes.description: Extends CustomPromptManagement to integrate Arize Phoenix prompt templates into LiteLLM, providing methods for prompt retrieval, rendering, pre-call hooks, and prompt compilation.
